chunks: They (had experienced) under the Pharaoh. He was certainly a tyrant, guilty of excess.

key_terms.الْمُسْرِفِينَ: the excessive / those who transgress bounds

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Pharaoh's character and status?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ad-Dukhan characterizes Pharaoh not merely as a political ruler but as the archetype of 'Al-iya' (arrogant elevation) and 'Musrifin' (those who exceed limits in sin), illustrating the spiritual decay of those who reject divine authority. This description serves as a thematic precursor to the broader narrative of Surah Ad-Dukhan, where Pharaoh's hubris is directly linked to the divine punishment of the 'Clear Day' (Yawm al-Mubin).
